title: Comparative Study of Prophylactic Agent for Venous Thromboembolism After Total Knee Arthroplasty
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the efficacy of two prophylactic agent(aspirin 300mg/day and rivaroxaban 10mg/day) for venous thromboembolism after total knee arthroplasty.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* all patients undergone primary total knee arthroplasty

Exclusion Criteria:

* renal insufficiency, contrast allergy, simultaneous bilateral TKA, hemorrhagic disorder, sever liver disease
